hero.title: Strategy and design to inhabit change.
hero.body1: Interactius was born in 2013 from a collaboration between a fine arts professor, Josep, and a computer engineering student, Carlos.
hero.body2: From that tension between the artistic and the technical emerges what we are today: a multidisciplinary team committed to humanizing technology.
hero.body3: We don't fit neatly into labels, nor do we wear them. We are a partner: close, committed, and focused on what truly matters. Working without pretense, with naturalness and judgment.
hero.body4: We don't wait for change to happen, nor do we let it sweep us away. We inhabit it. And from there, we move forward.

intro.quote: Leading change lies in understanding human complexity and its context.

0.title: We over I
0.body: We work from collaboration and trust, understanding that the best results emerge when people feel part of a shared purpose.

1.title: Truth before comfort
1.body: We work with clarity, even when it's uncomfortable. We name what's happening, not what would be easier to hear. We don't dress up diagnoses or design to please.

2.title: Questioning is how we move forward
2.body: We don't settle for the first answer or the obvious solution. We challenge assumptions, expand the frame, and revisit our own ideas when better evidence emerges.

3.title: Human complexity as the starting point
3.body: We design for people, aware that every decision impacts real lives. We listen before deciding and understand before simplifying.

liminal.title: Liminal Attitude
liminal.body1: Nothing new happens at the center. It is predictable, comfortable, and today, the fastest way to become irrelevant.
liminal.body2: That's why we chose to operate at the margins: in the ambiguous, the uncertain, what changes. That's where human truths live. And that's where we decided to stay.
liminal.body3: We work from that liminal space, between what is and what's yet to come. We do it by questioning the obvious and shifting focus, with judgment and human perspective.
liminal.body4: With this lens, we help organizations use design and strategy to inhabit change, think differently, and doubt better.
liminal.quote: We inhabit the margin to live within change.

0.label: Think
0.description: We name what has no shape yet.

1.label: Activate
1.description: We set in motion what matters.

2.label: Transform
2.description: We shape change so it endures.

gente.title: Our people
gente.description: We are a collective of restless minds who design, research, and build products for today's world.
